system.description: A leadership and teamwork style that sets foes up for allies, using cavalry weapons.
system.summary: A leadership and teamwork style that sets foes up for allies, using cavalry weapons.

entries.name: Weapon (Cavalry)
entries.effect: Special Attack must be made with a Cavalry weapon.

entries.name: Action (Charge)
entries.effect: Special Attacks may use the Charge action.

entries.name: Perfect Positioning
entries.effect: Only usable when the target has moved after your previous turn.

entries.name: Road-Clearing Technique
entries.effect: Up to your coming turn, allies attacking this foe get one free raise per purchase.

entries.name: Skill (Command)
entries.effect: Roll Command against the target's Static Defense as part of the attack; failure means the attack fails.

entries.name: Knight's Movement Concentration
entries.effect: Movement during or after this attack does not provoke opportunity attacks.

entries.name: Mastery (Marked Target)
entries.effect: Enemies in your melee reach must spend a reaction to attack your allies.

entries.name: Attention Drawing Strike
entries.effect: Targets hit cannot Parry or Dodge until their next turn.

entries.name: Wolf Pack Technique
entries.effect: Targets hit provoke an opportunity attack.
